component.name: Gosub Beacon
component.summary: Web browser built on the Gosub engine

description.p: Beacon is a GTK4 browser built on the Gosub engine. The engine does the actual work — networking, cookies, storage, history, rendering — and Beacon is the native chrome around it. It exists to test the engine in a real application, so it is not a daily driver yet, but basic browsing works.

ul.li: Page loading and rendering, with Skia rasterization and GPU compositing
Tabs, and back/forward over a tree-shaped session history
Session restore, bookmarks and visited history, with URL-bar completion
Downloads, favicons, error pages, a JSON viewer and syntax-highlighted view-source
Private windows, page zoom, and local file browsing over file://

description.p: Not working yet: JavaScript, forms and text input, and text selection.
First packaged build of the GTK frontend.
